skills.title: Enlightenment
skills.description: Monk cultivation (each rank requires another 50 invested Monk ranks, starting at 100): each rank reduces the growth factor that divides future ordinary global MXP awards by 0.001, without changing previously earned lifetime MXP levels. At base 1.020, 18 ranks yield 1.002; minimum 1.000.

skills.title: Empty Hand Force
skills.description: +0.30 unarmed damage per rank (+15 max), no normal armor. QA candidate: source handler present; numbers pending player testing.

skills.title: Flowing Counter
skills.description: Retaliation against real hostile melee hits, capped 10 damage, 40-tick cooldown. QA candidate: source handler present; numbers pending player testing.

skills.title: Empty Hand Precision
skills.description: +1 percentage point/rank chance of 1.5x fist strike (20% max). QA candidate: source handler present; numbers pending player testing.

skills.title: Fist Tempo
skills.description: +0.5% fist attack speed/rank (10% max). QA candidate: source handler present; numbers pending player testing.

skills.title: Paragon Force
skills.description: +2%/rank final fist damage (20% max), not duplicate of native Iron Palm. QA candidate: source handler present; numbers pending player testing.

skills.title: Pressure Points
skills.description: +1%/rank chance of short Slowness after real fist hit (5% max), bosses excluded. QA candidate: source handler present; numbers pending player testing.

skills.title: Empty Hand Paragon
skills.description: +5 fist damage and +3 armor unarmored; Curios allowed; Wither + late milestones required. QA candidate: source handler present; numbers pending player testing.

skills.title: Natural Poise
skills.description: +0.4 natural armor/rank (+16); effective defense audited versus already free armor. QA candidate: source handler present; numbers pending player testing.

skills.title: Iron Body
skills.description: +0.25 armor toughness/rank (+10), no normal armor. QA candidate: source handler present; numbers pending player testing.

skills.title: Inner Vitality
skills.description: +0.5 maximum health/rank (+20 HP), no normal armor. QA candidate: source handler present; numbers pending player testing.

skills.title: Quick Recovery
skills.description: +0.1 HP per second/rank passive regeneration (+2 HP/s). QA candidate: source handler present; numbers pending player testing.

skills.title: Elemental Tempering
skills.description: Reduce remaining fire and explosion damage, based solely on the damage type's vanilla fire/explosion tags. Exact-type spell wards are purchased separately.

skills.title: Hunger Mastery
skills.description: +1%/rank reduction in remaining exhaustion (20% max), above free Hunger Discipline. QA candidate: source handler present; numbers pending player testing.

skills.title: Body Speed
skills.description: +0.4%/rank base movement speed (+12%), conditionally unarmored. QA candidate: source handler present; numbers pending player testing.

skills.title: Balanced Landing
skills.description: +1%/rank reduction of remaining fall damage (20% max), after free Feather Fall. QA candidate: source handler present; numbers pending player testing.

skills.title: Evasion
skills.description: +0.5%/rank dodge against eligible direct attacks (10% max), not an immunity. QA candidate: source handler present; numbers pending player testing.

skills.title: Glide Control
skills.description: +1%/rank post-Dragon Momentum Glide control (20% max). QA candidate: source handler present; numbers pending player testing.

skills.title: Momentum Step
skills.description: +1%/rank sprint/strafe control bonus (20% max), no creative flight. QA candidate: source handler present; numbers pending player testing.

skills.title: Graceful Step
skills.description: +0.015 knockback resistance/rank (0.30 maximum). QA candidate: source handler present; numbers pending player testing.

skills.title: Barehand Efficiency
skills.description: +5%/rank legitimate final fist mining speed (+150% max), above free Hand Mining. QA candidate: source handler present; numbers pending player testing.

skills.title: Looting Palm
skills.description: +1.25%/rank chance for one extra ordinary mob drop on direct fist kill (25%), no boss loot. QA candidate: source handler present; numbers pending player testing.

skills.title: Toolless Reach
skills.description: +0.075 block reach/rank (+1.5 blocks), while fist is empty. QA candidate: source handler present; numbers pending player testing.

skills.title: Otherworld Sight
skills.description: Innate tier-two Otherworld texture reveal and tier-one native harvest access, without Demon's Dream, goggles, shader or potion. Iesnium still requires separate barehand training.

skills.title: Iesnium Palm
skills.description: With Otherworld Sight and normal barehand harvest eligibility, harvest naturally concealed Iesnium using the native uncovered loot state. No extra drops.

skills.title: Resonant Palm
skills.description: Toggle: barehanded matching ore veins, 3 additional ores per rank (16 total at rank 5). Requires normal harvest eligibility.

skills.title: Shattering Palm
skills.description: Toggle: barehanded one-layer excavation, 3x3 / 5x5 / 7x7 centered on the hit face. Skips unharvestable, protected, block-entity and excessively hard blocks. Resonant Palm takes priority on ores.

skills.title: Worldly Cultivation
skills.description: +1%/rank chance of additional ordinary mature-crop drop (20%). QA candidate: source handler present; numbers pending player testing.

skills.title: Inner Reservoir
skills.description: Extends every global Core Reservoir capacity family, much higher personal mana/EV/Psi endgame limits; no external tanks. QA candidate: source handler present; numbers pending player testing.

skills.title: Inner Wellspring
skills.description: Extends every global Core Wellspring regeneration family, improved personal recovery. QA candidate: source handler present; numbers pending player testing.

skills.title: Inner Thrift
skills.description: Extends every Core Thrift efficiency family; provisional +1%/rank bounded actual cost discount (20%), MXP tracks nominal. QA candidate: source handler present; numbers pending player testing.

skills.title: Inner Potency
skills.description: Extends every Core Potency family; provisional +1%/rank magic potency (20%). QA candidate: source handler present; numbers pending player testing.

skills.title: Arcane Attunement
skills.description: +0.5%/rank native casting speed/cooldown throughput where provider supports it (5%). QA candidate: source handler present; numbers pending player testing.

skills.title: Inner Fortune
skills.description: +1 true Luck attribute per rank (+10); not Fortune or Looting. QA candidate: source handler present; numbers pending player testing.

skills.title: Piercing Palm
skills.description: Each rank grants 1 percentage point of unarmed armor shredding while unarmored. Uses the existing Apothic Attributes armor_shred attribute; never converts magic/fire damage into armor penetration.

skills.title: Fortunate Hands
skills.description: Adds up to three virtual Fortune levels to the barehand Treasure Hand Fortune mode, using the original loot roll; inactive in Silk Touch mode and when using an equipped tool.

skills.title: Spellward
skills.description: Reduce remaining damage of the exact vanilla minecraft:magic damage type by 1% per rank, to 16%. Does not classify spells by caster, fire, explosion or projectile origin.

skills.title: Alchemical Ward
skills.description: Reduce remaining damage of the exact vanilla minecraft:indirect_magic damage type by 1% per rank, to 10%.

skills.title: Withering Ward
skills.description: Reduce remaining damage of the exact vanilla minecraft:wither damage type by 1% per rank, to 5%; not unrelated wither skull impact damage.

skills.title: Dragonbreath Ward
skills.description: Reduce remaining damage of the exact vanilla minecraft:dragon_breath damage type by 1% per rank, to 5%; not dragon melee hits.

skills.title: Elixir of Life
skills.description: The first approved beverage you genuinely consume becomes your personal Elixir. Each serving gives 10 fixed MXP, bonus saturation and golden-apple-level buffs. After binding, other sources cannot add saturation or ordinary restricted buffs. Harmful and protected effects remain. Binding persists until Path reset.

skills.title: Meditative Elixir
skills.description: Extend every newly applied finite beneficial MobEffect duration on the Monk by 2% per rank, to +20%, whether from potions, splash, spells or other effects. Only applies while the Monk's effect is active.
